titulo: The reel in 7 stages: plan before speech
hero_alt: A vertical phone on a dark table, with a script split into seven cards beside it.
lead: The r7e gives you the script: seven trigger parts, from a hook with a number to a request for comments. It took four batches of reels to reach the r7ex pattern: the content got right when the plan came before the spoken lines, and the form got right with a TV-news finish. Here you learn the plan, the seven parts, and the rules for the spoken lines.
objetivo: write a 30 to 45 s reel in 7 steps from a plan with audience, desire, hook with a number, score, and destination.

aprende.t: The plan in five fields, before writing the spoken lines
The seven parts, with the real example from the hacker reel
The rules for the spoken lines: length, numbers spelled out, CTA

secoes.titulo: From thesis to reel in r7ex
secoes.sub: Claude writes, Codex draws, HeyGen speaks, and the engine syncs everything to the voice.

nos.detalhe: Person, what they want, hook with a number or fact, potential score, and destination on inema.club. Below 7, change the angle or the topic before writing any spoken line.
python3 r7ex.py novo <slug> creates the sheet from the template. You write the plan, the opening, the seven parts (spoken line, image or screenshot, panel), the CTA, and where to publish.
r7ex.py checar requires 7 parts, a spoken line of 550 to 700 characters, and that every panel or counter word exists in the spoken line of that part.
Images by Codex, avatar by the HeyGen studio (only with the written OK in APROVADO_HEYGEN), scene, render, and the review sheet. You read the opening title and the sheet before sending.
It goes to the bot on Telegram and joins the end of the channel queue (1 every 2 hours). Never direct upload: the queue spaces out the posts and leaves time to hold back a video.

secoes.legenda: Example from the r7ex repository. For your channel, what matters is the order: plan → sheet → gate → media → review → queue.

rolagem_fim.texto: No avatar or render before the plan and the sheet gate. What costs money (avatar, images, render) only starts after the cheap part (text) has passed.

secoes.titulo: The 7 parts, in the hacker reel
secoes.sub: Real example from r7ex (published reel). The order of parts 2 to 6 adapts to the topic; it is always seven parts of ~30–40 s.

texto: Fear, novelty, or provocation, with a number or fact. Never defuse the trigger in the same sentence.

exemplo.texto: Hackers broke into OpenCode… US$ 1,700 in one night.

texto: Show why this hits the people watching. It can also be proof: "it has already happened 3 times".

exemplo.texto: The key is the password the AI uses… yours could be next.

passos.sub: how it looks if it works out
texto: The person pictures themselves on the other side of the problem.

exemplo.texto: Imagine sleeping soundly knowing that… the loss has a cap.

texto: Answers the "I'm not technical" or "I don't have time" before the person scrolls away.

exemplo.texto: You don't need to be an expert, or a programmer.

texto: This is where the name of the solution or the method goes, preferably in three items.

exemplo.texto: There are three adjustments: a limit, one key per use, an alarm…

texto: What life looks like afterward, or the "take advantage before…".

exemplo.texto: The scare turns into a notification on your phone…

texto: The fixed closing leads to inema.club and asks for a comment. In the reel7etapas the request is "comment WORD"; in the r7ex, "ask me for the link".

exemplo.texto: It's all on inema dot club. Or ask me for the link here in the comments.

secoes.titulo: The plan and script for your reel
secoes.sub: Fill in the plan first. If the score comes out below 7, change the angle before you write the script.

blocos.conteudo:
# Plano do reel

- Person (who is watching): 
- What they want (one sentence: win something, solve a pain, reach a desire): 
- Hook (fear, novelty or provocation, with a number or fact): 
- Source of the number: 
- Potential score (0–10) — "a stranger scrolling the feed would stop here?": 
- Destination (the page that solves it, becomes the proof screenshot):

| # | Parte | Fala (números por extenso) | Tela (imagem ou print + painel) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Hook (trigger + number) | | |
| 2 | Fear or proof | | |
| 3 | Desire | | |
| 4 | Ease | | |
| 5 | Discovery (3 items) | | |
| 6 | Benefit or urgency | | |
| 7 | Comment | Tá tudo no <seu site>. Ou me pede o link aqui nos comentários. | |

Total speech: 550 to 700 characters (~30–40 s).

abas.html:
• Batch 1 (hook = promise, blurred photo): no views on TikTok or Instagram.
  • Batch 2 (only the hook became a trigger with a number): better, "still average".
  • Batch 3 (plan before the script, strong theses, fixed CTA, real screenshots): the content hit the mark.
  • Batch 4, r7ex (same script, newscast-style finish): the form hit the mark. Standard since 10/18/2026.

Script of 550 to 700 characters. Numbers and years written out in words, because the avatar reads them; the caption swaps them for digits. Never make up a number; "free" only when the page says so.

The plan targets a general audience (AI translated into everyday life), not the niche, because the goal of the reel is to bring in new people.

exercicios.texto: Fill in the plano.md and write the 30-to-45-second reel for your niche using the 7-part model. Read it aloud and time yourself.
exercicios.pronto: you read it aloud in under 45 s, the plan score is 7 or higher, and the first sentence already hooks (in the r7ex standard: the trigger with a number or fact).

secoes.fonte: The original exercise list says "the first sentence already states the gain". The r7ex standard (10/18/2026) swapped the gain for the trigger with a number in the hook, after batches with no views. Exercises: jornada-agentes/exercicios/04-redes.md.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: Your plan scored 5 on "a stranger scrolling the feed would stop here?". What do you do?
opcoes: Change the angle or the topic before writing the script.
Write the script and see how it turns out.
perguntas.explica: Below 7, you change the angle or the topic. The plan exists precisely so you make mistakes on the cheap part (text), not the expensive part (avatar and render).

perguntas.p: Which of these is a hook in the r7ex standard?
opcoes: "Hackers broke into OpenCode: US$ 1,700 in one night."
"Comment SECURITY and I'll send you the link."
"Hi, today I'm going to talk about security."
perguntas.explica: Hook = trigger (fear, novelty, or provocation) with a number or a fact. "Spends less" is a promise, the hook from batch 1, which got no views.

perguntas.p: Why does the script write "mil e setecentos" instead of "1.700"?
opcoes: It doesn't need to: it makes no difference.
Because the avatar reads the script; the caption is what swaps in the numerals.
perguntas.explica: The avatar reads the text as written. Spelled out, it pronounces it right; the on-screen caption shows the numerals.

perguntas.p: What did the four batches show?
opcoes: That all you need is to post more times a day.
That a full-screen avatar goes viral more.
That the content got it right with the plan before the script (batch 3) and the form got it right with the newscast-style finish (batch 4).
perguntas.explica: Content and form were fixed in different batches. r7ex combined the script from batch 3 with the engine from batch 4.
